body: ## Purpose
How to answer "what is my credit balance?" from the support console. This page covers reading balances only.
## Where balances live
Each credit a customer holds is a row in `credit_grants`. The current balance of a grant is its `remaining_cents`; the customer's balance is the sum across their grants."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/support-console-billing-credits-and-disputes.json", "chunk": "3/4", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-05", "text": "(continued) ## Duplicate charges: what Support may credit
| Situation | What Support does |
|---|---|
| Confirmed duplicate, duplicated line over the limit | Don't credit. Open a dispute on the duplicated line (reason `duplicate_charge`, with the request IDs) and hand the case to Billing Ops with the invoice number, the line and the dispute id. |
| Duplicate the console doesn't confirm (different request IDs, or no second line) | Don't credit. Collect the intake details and hand the case to Billing Ops as the routing page describes. |
Support's limit is set by Finance in the Billing Adjustments Approval Matrix (Finance shared drive) (the duplicate-charge credit row). It is per duplicated line and applies to the line's full amount. - Look up the customer's billing account in the console before you quote an amount, a plan, an invoice line, or whether a charge is a duplicate. You can find the account by its account id or by the customer's org name; ask for one of them if the customer hasn't given either.
- Quote amounts as the console shows them. Don't restate a figure the customer gives you as fact.
## Duplicate charges: what Support may credit
A charge is a confirmed duplicate only when the console shows two lines on the same direct Redwood invoice that bill the same request IDs. A similar description or the same amount on its own is not enough.
| Situation | What Support does |
|---|---|
| Confirmed duplicate, duplicated line within Support's limit | Issue one credit note with reason `duplicate` for the full amount of the duplicated line, against that line. No handoff is needed. |---|---|---|

| SLA credit on a self-serve account | Finance (FP&A) | Self-serve plans carry no SLA. FP&A reviews any request as goodwill |
| SLA credit under a signed contract | Account team files the claim; Finance approves | Per the contract's SLA terms. body: ## Purpose
How Support handles a card payment that failed and a request to change the card used for autopay. Invoice disputes and usage questions are covered on the billing case routing page.
## Failed card payments
When a customer's card payment fails, open a Billing Ops case with the invoice number, the decline code and the time the payment failed. Billing Ops retries the payment or contacts the customer. Tell the customer Billing Ops has it; don't promise a date."}]}
